data.name: Joashua
data.gender_notes: Joashua is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The LORD is my salvation. This name is derived from the Hebrew name 'Yehoshua' (יהושע), which consists of two elements: 'Yah', a short form of the Hebrew name for God (YHWH), and 'shua', meaning salvation. In the Bible, Joshua is the successor of Moses, leading the Israelites into the Promised Land. The name Joashua carries the meaning “God is salvation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Joashua usually hope their child will grow to embody god is salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of faith and devotion, symbolizing God's saving power and guidance in one's life.
data.etymology: Joashua belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is salvation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joashua total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: יהושע
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יהושע הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'ה' הוא הישועיה' או 'ישוע הוא ה''. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'יהו' - שמו של ה', ו-'שע' - ישועיה או ישוע. השם יהושע ניתן לאחד הבנים של המלך יהוא של ישראל, וגם לנושא אחר בתנ'ך.

in_greek.name: Ιωαση
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιωαση είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος יהושע (Yehoshua), που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι σωτηρία' ή 'σωτηρία από τον Θεό'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα αυτό δεν αναφέρεται συχνά, αλλά το αντίστοιχο εβραϊκό όνομα יהושע (Yehoshua) είναι γνωστό ως Ιησούς στα ελληνικά.

in_latin.name: Ioasua
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ioasua derivatur ex hebraeo nomine יהושע (Yehoshua), quod significat 'Deus salus' vel 'salus a Deo'. In ecclesia primitiva, nomen hoc non invenitur frequenter, sed nomen eiusdem originis יהושע (Yehoshua) transliteratum est in Iesus.

in_english.name: Joashua
in_english.meaning: God is salvation or God saves
in_english.long_meaning: The name Joashua is derived from the Hebrew name יהושע (Yehoshua), which means 'God is salvation' or 'God saves'. This name is a variant of the more commonly known name Joshua, which has been used in Christian tradition to signify one who brings salvation or deliverance. Historically, the name has been associated with strength and divine guidance.
